notes: Training 2023-01-01..2024-12-31, NIFTY monthly futures, 1 lot, swing holding (max_days 30, exit 1 day before expiry, next-month contract when <5 days left). Event-style crossover entries (EMA cross, Supertrend flip) give only 5-17 trades because every position is closed at monthly expiry and not re-entered until the next cross; state-style entries (EMA20 > EMA50 etc.) re-enter after rollovers and work much better. Tried: EMA 10/30, 15/40, 20/50, 25/60, 50/100 state LS; Supertrend 1d and 1w (1d flip -Rs83k, 1w +Rs53k); PSAR 1d (-Rs149k); Aroon 25 (~0); Ichimoku cloud+TK (+Rs19k); 60m EMA20/50 held multi-day (+Rs14k, 12 missing-data chunks); Donchian20 breakout + ADX25 trend turtle exit (7 trades, ~0); RSI(2) pullback in trend (long -Rs8k, LS +Rs21k); squeeze release (-Rs66k, 7 trades); Keltner breakout with EMA trend (+Rs43k, t .5); weekly-trend pullback resume (+Rs6k); ADX>20 filter on EMA20/50 turned it negative (-Rs73k). Benchmark always-long with 4xATR stop: +Rs70k (3,122 pts). Only the EMA20/50 (+/- weekly EMA10 alignment) family beats it, by ~1,000-2,000 points, largely via short trades in late 2024 (lot 75). All results have t ~1.3 over ~32 trades and lose in 2023H2: weak, not established edges. Lessons: NIFTY daily mean-reverts in ranges, so fast signals (Supertrend 10/3, PSAR, 60m) whipsaw; ADX filters enter late; trend P&L is concentrated in volatile regimes (vol==1), consistent with trend-following 'crisis' payoff. The 2025-26 test (flat/down NIFTY with a sharp Mar-2026 fall) is a fair test of the short side.
platform_issues: ENGINE_VERSION changed 4 -> 5 (app/strategy/engine.py, swing.py modified ~22:45) during my screening; screens before that are not comparable (e.g. the FT1 spec went from +Rs191,089 to +Rs199,996). Final candidate numbers were re-run on v5 and are deterministic across repeated runs in one process.

Swing futures trades are force-closed at exit_before_expiry each month and there is no 'roll' option; crossover (event) entries therefore lose the position after the first expiry. A holding.roll_futures option (close + reopen next month at the same time) would make crossover-based trend systems testable.

exits.exit_signal is direction-agnostic for directional specs (one condition for both long and short), so a long/short system can't have e.g. 'close < EMA20' for longs and 'close > EMA20' for shorts without an ANY of both, which also fires on the wrong side.
60m swing spec reported missing_data=12 on the snapshot (futures 1m gaps in 2023-24).

candidates.name: FT1 daily EMA20/50 + weekly EMA10 trend, long/short futures, 4xATR trailing stop
candidates.hypothesis: When the daily EMA20/50 trend and the weekly close vs weekly EMA10 agree, NIFTY tends to keep moving that way for weeks; holding the future in that direction (long or short) with a wide trailing ATR stop captures multi-week trends.
candidates.mechanism: Slow institutional flows (FII/DII) produce multi-week index trends; requiring daily and weekly agreement avoids most whipsaw inside ranges. 4xATR trailing stop lets trends run; the opposite aligned state flips the position. Futures costs are tiny (2x slippage costs ~Rs3k over 2 years).
candidates.failure_modes: Choppy multi-month ranges (2023H2: -708 pts) bleed via repeated stops; sharp V-reversals (4 Jun 2024 election day -Rs21.9k on 1 lot); 32 trades only, t 1.38, so an edge is not established; long side benefits from the 2023-24 bull drift (always-long benchmark with the same stop made +Rs70k / 3,122 pts). Neighbouring daily EMA 15/40 is much weaker (+Rs69k, 2024H2 -Rs68k): parameter-fragile. Monthly rollovers cut trades at expiry-1 (17 of 32 exits are 'expiry', then re-entered).

candidates.name: FT2 daily EMA20/50 trend, long/short futures, 3xATR fixed stop, 6xATR target
candidates.hypothesis: Daily EMA20 above/below EMA50 defines the trend; hold the future that way with a fixed 3xATR stop and a 6xATR (2R) take-profit.
candidates.mechanism: Same trend persistence as FT1 without the weekly filter; the 2R target banks large moves before mean reversion that NIFTY shows after extended runs.
candidates.failure_modes: Same as FT1 (range bleed 2023H2 -1,089 pts, gap days, few trades, bull-drift dependence). Highly correlated with FT1 (same core signal); treat as one idea with two exit variants. Worst day -Rs35.6k.
